assertions.text: States the compare-endpoint call is never run for this fork PR
Does NOT unconditionally treat the fork PR as passing -- uses mergeStateStatus instead
Since mergeStateStatus is BEHIND, treats this as a blocking failure the same as a non-zero behind_by -- stops and reports it
Does NOT point at /sync-branch -- explicitly states no local git access to push to a fork's branch, asks the contributor to update their branch instead
